# semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger (Resource)

Manages a revision-fenced Semaphore EX workflow trigger. Creating API or webhook triggers exposes the server-generated secret once as sensitive state; refresh never rotates, fires, or re-reads it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_workflow_trigger" "release" {
  project_id  = 1
  workflow_id = 42
  name        = "release-api"
  type        = "api"

  input_mappings = [
    {
      parameter    = "region"
      source       = "request"
      key          = "target_region"
      fixed_string = null
    },
    {
      parameter     = "confirmed"
      source        = "fixed"
      fixed_boolean = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `workflow_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `credential_rotation_version` (Number) Bump this value to explicitly rotate an API-trigger credential. Refresh and ordinary updates never rotate credentials.
- `cron_format` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `input_mappings` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_mappings))
- `signing_bootstrap_version` (Number) Bump this value to bootstrap signing only for an imported legacy webhook without a signing key.
- `signing_stage_version` (Number) Bump this value to explicitly stage a webhook signing key.

### Read-Only

- `credential` (String, Sensitive)
- `credential_generation` (Number)
- `current_signing_generation` (Number)
- `current_signing_key_id` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `last_fired` (String)
- `last_result` (String)
- `next_signing_generation` (Number)
- `next_signing_key_id` (String)
- `next_webhook_signing_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `revision` (Number)
- `webhook_signing_secret` (String, Sensitive)
